headline: Cape Lines Shift Anew as Nevish Front Falls Quiet
war_summary: The weight of the fighting has moved. Callum's Cape, which stood six Warden works and one unclaimed at the last edition, now reads four Warden and three Colonial, with eleven actions inside two hours — the heaviest concentration in the packet — and better than a thousand Colonial and eleven hundred Warden casualties in that same span. The Nevish Line, reopened under fire at the previous report, has gone quiet: no actions in two hours, three in six, and both casualty rates falling, though the line still stands eight Colonial against none. Mooring County remains the bloodiest ledger of the watch, near eleven thousand Colonial and ten thousand Warden dead in the day, the Wardens adding a work to stand eleven against one Colonial. Marban Hollow's Wardens recovered ground, now four works to three Colonial and one unclaimed. Linn Mercy holds ten Colonial and one unclaimed, its casualty rate still climbing sharply. Godcrofts is newly ablaze about Isawa, seven actions in two hours, with losses on both sides spiking. The Weathered Expanse fights on at three actions, seven Warden and two unclaimed.
